I will now use the `Hardware` agent to execute the Python script that was generated in the previous step. This script will implement the primer design algorithm and generate a list of candidate primer pairs.

Here is my reasoning for choosing this agent and its parameters:

`agent_name`: `Hardware`

`params`:
- `file_ids`: `['Code-cdfd']`. I am providing the file ID of the Python script that was generated by the `Code` agent. This is the script that will be executed.
- `repeat_num`: `1`. The primer design script only needs to be run once to generate the results.
- `pure_software`: `True`. As established in the previous steps, this is a purely software-based task, so this flag is set to `True`.
